---
title: "DEGs among different cell types"
author: "jack"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

I'm interested in the spatial distribution of IEG expression, so let's load some of that data in.

```{r distro by IEG}
# find proportion of cells expressing Npas4 above 0 in each supertype
df_active_cells <- FindActiveCells(nuclei, gene_type='IEG') |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(num_upregd_IEGs:last_col(), -num_upregd_IEGs), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression") |>
  mutate(is_expressing = expression > 0) |> 
  right_join(nuclei@meta.data, by = c("cell" = "bc_wells", "condition" = "condition")) |> 
  filter(subclass_name == '016 CA1-ProS Glut')

df_supertype_active  <- df_active_cells |>
  group_by(supertype_name, condition) |> 
  summarise(fraction_active = sum(active_binary) / n()) |> print()


# plot activation by supertype
df_active_cells |> 
  left_join(df_supertype_active, by = c("supertype_name", "condition")) |> 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = supertype_name, y = num_upregd_IEGs, fill = condition) +
  geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 10)) +
  labs(title = "Activation by supertype",
    x = "Supertype", y = "IEGs with expression\n>90th percentile") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = 'none',
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~condition)


# plot active cells by supertype along anatomical axes
ca1_merfish |> 
  group_by(z, supertype) |>  
  summarise(n = n()) |> 
  mutate(composition = n / sum(n)) |> 
  left_join(df_supertype_active, by = c("supertype" = "supertype_name")) |> 
  mutate(height = composition * fraction_active) |>
ggplot() +
  geom_area(aes(x = z, y = height, fill = supertype), position = 'stack') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(7.5,4,-0.2), color = 'white', linetype = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = supertype_colors) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Active CA1 cells along A-P axis",
    x = "<-- anterior / posterior -->", y = "Proportion of active cells by supertype"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9),
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~condition)
```
